final: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS station_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth), SUM(p.station_count), AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - m.mean_bandwidth) FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > m.mean_bandwidth
